oracle-l5r-5599: No Hiding Place: "Reaction: After you announce an action with a Ranged Attack: Give one Ranged Attack from the action -1 strength. That Ranged Attack may target a card in the Defender's home (if otherwise legal)." Still blocked, for the reason AttackTargeting.cs (GrantAttackFollowerException) already records: an Attack's target is chosen and validated ONCE, in the announcing useAbility command (ValidateAbility / RequireLegalAttackTarget), and PendingAttack.TargetId is fixed from then on; the announce window (FindAnnounceWatcher / the announceReaction window Tsuruchi Yakusho uses) opens AFTER that validation, so a Reaction there can neither legalise a target the announcement rejected (a card in the Defender's home is never a legal Attack target today: Attack targets must be at the current battlefield) nor re-select the target. To build it: (1) a target re-selection step in the announce window (the Attack's target, or its province, chosen after the Reaction, with the declaring command carrying no target, or carrying a provisional one); (2) a per-announced-action record (like RangedAttackStrengthReductionImmune, MatchState) holding the -1 strength delta and a 'may target a card in the Defender's home' permission consumed by the first Ranged Attack the action produces; (3) RequireLegalAttackTarget and the Attack reaction windows accepting a Defender's-home card under that permission (its 'location' being the Defender's home, so location-keyed reactions such as Ezuno/Yojimbo redirects read it correctly). 'One Ranged Attack from the action' also needs the action's Attacks counted (only single-Attack actions exist today).
oracle-l5r-6260: Rend the Soul: two halves, neither expressible with today's primitives. (1) "As a Focus Effect: Raise this card's Focus Value to 5. If your Personality wins this duel, he loses instead (the other Personality still also loses)." Dueling.cs totals a focused card's PRINTED Focus (+ the Duel to First Blood +1 per-card bonus); there is no 'raise this card's Focus Value to N' Focus Effect (a per-focused-card override read by the duel totals) and no outcome rewrite that makes the winner take the loser's consequences as well as the loser (ApplyDuelOutcome / winnerId,loserIds are computed once from the totals; a tie has no winner, so 'both lose' is not a state of the resolution). (2) "Battle: Choose your performing opposed Personality: Give him +5F. If the army he is in during this battle's resolution wins, this battle is tied instead. You will not destroy the province in this battle's resolution." The +5F is an ordinary modifier, but MatchEngine.ContinueResolveBattle has no hook that (a) reads which army a marked Personality is in when the battle resolves and, if that army would win, resolves the battle as the existing tie (each side destroys the other army, tie Honor rules) instead, or (b) carries a per-battle 'this player will not destroy the province' flag consulted where the margin over province strength is judged. To build it: a MatchState record of marked Personalities + 'no province destruction for player P' for the current battle (cleared with the battle, like Nerve Strike's ActionLockUntilBattleEnd), read in ContinueResolveBattle right after the totals are compared; and, for the Focus Effect, a FocusEffect kind 'raise-focus-to' plus a duel-outcome kind 'winner-also-loses' in ApplyDuelFocusEffect. Both halves must ship together (an unwired half is a partially working card).
